note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-24 against RFC 5798 Section 7.2 (rfc/full/rfc5798.txt): "The following operations MUST be performed when transmitting a VRRP packet: - Fill in the VRRP packet fields with the appropriate virtual router configuration state - Compute the VRRP checksum" (superseded restated RFC9568-7.2-1). Verified changes since 4bbcaa15ca (1adbcc4337): backend_linux.go::openV6 added parentRxFD for unicast advertisement reception while keeping unix.SetsockoptInt(txFD, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_CHECKSUM, 6) at line 241. All four tagged test units are byte-identical: field filling and IPv4 rfc5798-compatible pseudo-header checksum are proven by TestTransmittedAdvertFilledFromInstanceState, TestSendAdvertFillsFieldsAndChecksum, TestEncodeGoldenV3IPv4, and TestBoundaryInterval (negative). However, the IPv6 checksum clause remains unproven by any tagged unit: TestSendAdvertFillsFieldsAndChecksum runs a fakeBackend whose IPv6 subtest checks fields only and no checksum, and TestTransmittedAdvertFilledFromInstanceState computes FillChecksum in the test body rather than through openV6. Removing IPV6_CHECKSUM from openV6 leaves every tagged unit green. Verdict remains weak.
